title: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩
titleZh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩
imageAlt: A hand pulls back from a warning snake after an earlier bite, illustrating greater caution after a bad experience.
imageAltZh: 一隻手曾經被咬後，對警戒中的蛇退縮，呈現受過一次傷害後更加謹慎的意思。
imageCaption: The earlier bite represents a bad experience; pulling back represents the caution that follows.
imageCaptionZh: 先前的咬傷代表不愉快經歷；其後退縮代表由此產生的謹慎。

provenance.normalization: The source was mapped into the established eight-page Proverb System with Chinese-primary explanation and restrained target-phrase highlighting.

sourceOmissions.reason: Excluded under the established lesson-format SOP; relevant usage guidance is represented without a separate communicative-function block.

sourceOmissions.section: The Original Image · 原來的畫面
sourceOmissions.reason: Excluded under the established lesson-format SOP.

examples.en: Once bitten, twice shy: Rachel now asks for a written agreement before paying any new company.
examples.zh: 吃過一次虧，Rachel 現在會在付款給任何新公司前，先要求一份書面協議。

meaning.en: After somebody has been hurt, disappointed, deceived or otherwise affected by an unpleasant experience, they become more cautious or reluctant when facing the same or a similar situation again.
meaning.zh: 某人曾經受傷、失望、受騙或經歷不愉快的事情後，再遇到相同或類似情況時，便會變得更加小心、猶豫或不願再次冒險。
naturalZh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩
吃過一次虧，便加倍小心
有了上次的教訓，今次不敢大意
曾經受過傷，因此不敢輕易再試
因過往的不愉快經歷而變得謹慎
前車可鑑，不敢重蹈覆轍
meaning.tendencyEn: The bite is normally figurative, and shy means cautious or reluctant rather than socially quiet. A suitable context links an earlier bad experience to later caution in a related situation.
meaning.tendencyZh: bite 通常屬比喻用法；shy 表示謹慎或不願再次冒險，而不是社交上的害羞。合適語境會把先前的不愉快經歷與其後相關情況中的謹慎連繫起來。

modelExample.sourceEn: The last company charged Rachel for work it never completed. She now asks for a written agreement before paying any new company.
modelExample.sourceZh: 上一間公司向 Rachel 收取了沒有完成的工作費用。她現在會在付款給任何新公司前，先要求一份書面協議。
modelExample.answerEn: Once bitten, twice shy: Rachel now asks for a written agreement before paying any new company.
modelExample.answerZh: 吃過一次虧，Rachel 現在會在付款給任何新公司前，先要求一份書面協議。
preservedEn: present caution caused by past experience
preservedZh: 上一間公司未完成工作
過往經歷造成目前的謹慎
modelExample.compressedEn: A previous bad experience has made Rachel more cautious in a similar situation.
modelExample.compressedZh: 先前的不愉快經歷令 Rachel 在類似情況中變得更加謹慎。

register.summaryEn: The proverb is natural in everyday communication and can communicate sensible caution, fear, hesitation, distrust, regret, sympathy or mild humour, depending on context.
register.summaryZh: 這句諺語自然地用於日常溝通，並可按語境帶出理性謹慎、恐懼、猶豫、不信任、後悔、同情或輕微幽默。
contextsEn: comments about trust, risk and past mistakes
contextsZh: 有關信任、風險及過往錯誤的評論

tones.en: The speaker presents later checks or safeguards as an understandable lesson from experience.
tones.zh: 說話者把其後的核對或保障措施，描述成從經驗汲取的合理教訓。

tones.en: The proverb can explain why trust has weakened or why somebody is reluctant to try again.
tones.zh: 這句諺語可以解釋信任為甚麼減弱，或某人為甚麼不願再次嘗試。

tones.en: In an ordinary, low-stakes situation, it may gently acknowledge a person's increased caution.
tones.zh: 在一般而風險不高的情況中，它可以溫和地表示理解某人變得更加小心。

sensitiveContextsEn: situations requiring sustained empathy rather than a short proverb
sensitiveContextsZh: 需要持續同理而不適合只用一句諺語回應的情況
register.sensitivityEn: Using a short proverb in response to severe trauma, abuse or serious loss may sound dismissive or lacking in sympathy.
register.sensitivityZh: 如果別人正在談論嚴重創傷、虐待或重大損失，只以一句簡短諺語回應，可能令人覺得說話者輕視對方的感受或缺乏同理心。
register.formalEn: The proverb suits general communication. In highly formal analysis, explain the earlier experience and later caution directly if the connection may not be obvious.
register.formalZh: 這句諺語適合一般溝通。在高度正式的分析中，如果前因後果未必清楚，應直接說明先前經歷與其後謹慎之間的關係。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: All four words remain fixed, and the comma after bitten should normally be retained.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 四個字全部屬於固定部分；bitten 後面的逗號通常必須保留。

capitalisation.en: Capitalise Once when the proverb begins a sentence.
capitalisation.zh: 諺語放在句首時，Once 的第一個字母使用大寫。

capitalisation.labelEn: At the end of a sentence
capitalisation.example: She now checks every detail—once bitten, twice shy.
capitalisation.en: Lower case is natural after a dash inside a longer sentence.
capitalisation.zh: 在較長句子中放在破折號後時，通常使用小寫。

fixedVariable.variableEn: The proverb does not normally change. What changes is the grammatical frame around it and the explanation of the earlier experience or later caution.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 目標諺語本身通常不會改變；可以改變的是前後的句法框架，以及先前經歷或其後謹慎的說明。
variableItemsEn: a concluding comment after a dash

forms.exampleZh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。

forms.example: Once bitten, twice shy: I now check every detail.
forms.exampleZh: 吃過一次虧，我現在會核對每項細節。

forms.example: As the saying goes, once bitten, twice shy.
forms.exampleZh: 正所謂一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。

forms.example: It was a case of once bitten, twice shy.
forms.exampleZh: 這正是一朝被蛇咬、十年怕草繩。
Priya 解釋道：「一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。」

forms.example: He now pays only after delivery—once bitten, twice shy.
forms.exampleZh: 他現在只會在收貨後付款；有了上次教訓，自然更加小心。

specificForms.descriptionEn: Use the proverb alone only when the previous bad experience is already clear from the conversation.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 只有當對話中已清楚交代先前的不愉快經歷時，才適合單獨使用。

examples.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。

specificForms.formula: Once bitten, twice shy: + complete clause.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Use a colon when the following clause explains how the person has become more cautious.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 後面的句子解釋某人現在如何變得更加謹慎時，可以使用冒號。

examples.en: Once bitten, twice shy: I now read every agreement carefully.
examples.zh: 吃過一次虧，我現在會仔細閱讀每份協議。

specificForms.formula: As the saying goes, once bitten, twice shy.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Introduce the expression explicitly as a well-known saying.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 明確把這個表達作為廣為人知的諺語引入。

examples.en: As the saying goes, once bitten, twice shy. I will check the details more carefully this time.
examples.zh: 正所謂一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。今次我會更加仔細核對資料。

specificForms.formula: It is / was a case of once bitten, twice shy.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Describe a particular person's situation as an instance of the proverb.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 把某人的具體情況描述成這句諺語的一個例子。

examples.en: For Aaron, it was a case of once bitten, twice shy: he had lost money before and would not take the same risk again.
examples.zh: 對 Aaron 而言，這正是一朝被蛇咬、十年怕草繩：他以前曾損失金錢，所以不願再冒同樣風險。

specificForms.formula: Complete clause + dash + once bitten, twice shy.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The dash separates the situation from the speaker's concluding comment.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 破折號把具體情況與說話者的總結分開。

examples.en: She now asks for everything in writing—once bitten, twice shy.
examples.zh: 她現在會要求所有事情以書面確認；畢竟吃過一次虧，自然會更加小心。

specificForms.formula: “Once bitten, twice shy,” + speaker + reporting verb.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Quote the proverb directly and identify the speaker with a reporting clause.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 直接引用整句諺語，再以轉述小句指出說話者。

examples.zh: Clara 解釋道：「一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。」

notes.en: In standard British dialogue punctuation, the comma appears inside the closing quotation mark when a reporting clause follows.
notes.zh: 在標準英式對話標點中，如果引號後接報告句，逗號會放在結束引號之內。

benefits.titleEn: It Connects Past Experience with Present Behaviour
benefits.titleZh: 把過往經歷與目前行為連繫起來
benefits.en: The proverb clearly links an earlier unpleasant experience with present caution.
benefits.zh: 這個諺語把過往的不愉快經歷與目前的謹慎行為清楚連繫起來。

examples.en: She checks every seller carefully now—once bitten, twice shy.
examples.zh: 她現在會仔細查核每名賣家；吃過一次虧，自然更加小心。

benefits.en: It expresses in one short saying that a bad experience has made somebody worried and more careful.
benefits.zh: 一句簡短諺語便可表達「曾經吃虧，所以現在更加謹慎」這個完整意思。

examples.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。

benefits.titleEn: It Explains Reluctance Without Calling It Irrational
benefits.titleZh: 解釋猶豫，而不一定批評對方不理性
benefits.en: The expression often presents caution as an understandable result of experience.
benefits.zh: 這個表達通常把謹慎描述為過往經驗所造成的合理反應，而不一定是在批評對方過分膽小。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Describe Different Levels of Caution
benefits.titleZh: 可以表達不同程度的謹慎
benefits.en: The person may stop, delay, check more carefully, ask for proof, try on a smaller scale or proceed only under conditions.
benefits.zh: 當事人可以完全停止、延遲決定、更加仔細檢查、要求證明、先作小規模嘗試，或只在符合條件時再次參與。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful as a Conversational Response
benefits.titleZh: 適合作為自然的對話回應
benefits.en: When both speakers know the background, the proverb can form a short but meaningful reply.
benefits.zh: 當雙方已知道事情背景時，這句諺語可以構成簡短而有意義的回應。

examples.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Learners Understand Authentic English
benefits.titleZh: 幫助學生理解真實英語
benefits.en: The saying commonly appears when people discuss trust, risk, disappointment and lessons learned from experience.
benefits.zh: 人們談論信任、風險、失望或從經驗中汲取教訓時，經常會使用這句諺語。

origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切來源不明

history.en: The general lesson that a person becomes cautious after being harmed is older than the modern wording, but this does not prove that one ancient story directly created the English proverb. A close early form, “once bit twice shy,” appears in Rachel Hunter's 1806 novel Lady Maclairn, the Victim of Villany.
history.zh: 「受過傷害後便會變得謹慎」這個道理遠早於現代英文句式，但不能證明某一個古代故事直接創造了這句諺語。一個非常接近的早期形式 once bit twice shy 出現在 Rachel Hunter 1806 年的小說 Lady Maclairn, the Victim of Villany 中。

history.en: The early form used bit rather than bitten. The modern wording once bitten, twice shy was recorded in G. F. Northall's 1894 collection Folk-Phrases of Four Counties. Historical references also distinguish the British once bitten form from the American once burned variant.
history.zh: 較早期形式使用 bit，而不是 bitten。現代形式 once bitten, twice shy 收錄於 G. F. Northall 在 1894 年出版的 Folk-Phrases of Four Counties。歷史資料亦把英式 once bitten 與美式 once burned 變體區分開來。

history.en: Today, the proverb means that a previous failure, injury or disappointment has made somebody more cautious about trying something similar again.
history.zh: 今天，這句諺語表示某人因先前的失敗、傷害或失望，在再次面對類似事情時變得更加小心。

origin.memoryEn: The first bite causes the later shyness: one bad experience produces greater caution next time.
origin.memoryZh: 第一次「被咬」造成其後的「退縮」：一次不愉快的經歷，令人下一次更加謹慎。

rules.titleZh: 所有字詞必須保持不變
rules.en: Use the exact four-word expression; a similar phrase such as once hurt, twice shy is not the target.
rules.zh: 必須使用四個字的完整目標表達；once hurt, twice shy 即使意思相近，也不是本練習指定的諺語。

examples.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩

rules.en: The comma reflects the parallel relationship between the two parts and should normally be retained.
rules.zh: 逗號反映前後兩部分的平行及因果關係，通常必須保留。

examples.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。

rules.titleZh: bitten 通常屬於比喻意思
rules.en: The speaker need not have been physically bitten. Bitten can represent deception, financial loss, disappointment, poor service, a costly mistake or another unpleasant result.
rules.zh: 說話者不需要真的曾經被動物咬傷。bitten 可以比喻受騙、損失金錢、失望、差劣服務、代價高昂的錯誤或其他不愉快後果。

rules.titleEn: Shy Does Not Mean Socially Quiet
rules.titleZh: shy 並非指社交上的害羞
rules.en: Here, shy means cautious, nervous or unwilling to take the same risk again.
rules.zh: 在這句諺語中，shy 表示謹慎、擔心或不願再次冒相同風險。

rules.titleZh: 必須包含兩個時間階段
rules.en: A suitable context contains an earlier unpleasant experience and later caution in a similar situation.
rules.zh: 合適語境包括較早前的不愉快經歷，以及其後面對類似情況時所表現的謹慎。

examples.en: Once bitten, twice shy: I now check every seller carefully.
examples.zh: 吃過一次虧，我現在會仔細查核每名賣家。

rules.titleEn: The Later Situation Must Be Related
rules.titleZh: 後來的情況必須與原先經歷有關
rules.en: The later precaution must respond to the same or a genuinely similar risk.
rules.zh: 其後採取的預防措施，必須回應相同或真正相近的風險。

rules.titleEn: It Does Not Always Mean Complete Refusal
rules.en: It may mean refusing, waiting, asking questions, checking details, making a smaller commitment, requiring protection or proceeding under conditions.
rules.zh: 它可以表示拒絕、等待、提問、核對細節、先作較小承諾、要求保障，或只在特定條件下行動。

rules.titleZh: 保留確定程度及情態意思
rules.en: Do not turn may be more careful into a definite and permanent refusal.
rules.zh: 不可把「可能會更加小心」改成確定而永久的拒絕。

examples.en: He may be more careful next time—once bitten, twice shy.
examples.zh: 他下次可能會更加小心；畢竟吃過一次虧。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Without a Bad First Experience
rules.titleZh: 沒有先前的不愉快經歷時，不應使用
rules.en: Ordinary careful research, without an earlier hurt, deception or disappointment, does not establish the proverb's meaning.
rules.zh: 如果沒有先前的受傷、受騙或失望，只是一般仔細研究，便未能構成這句諺語的意思。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Whole Meaning
rules.titleZh: 不要在使用諺語後完整重複其意思
rules.en: Let the proverb compress the connection between the past experience and present caution; add a concrete current action instead of repeating the definition.
rules.zh: 讓諺語濃縮「過往經歷導致現在謹慎」的意思；其後應加入具體行動，而不是重複定義。

examples.en: Once bitten, twice shy: he now checks every agreement before signing it.
examples.zh: 吃過一次虧，他現在會在簽署前仔細檢查每份協議。

rules.titleEn: Related Variants Are Not the Target
rules.titleZh: 相關變體不是本練習目標
rules.en: Once bit, twice shy, once burned, twice shy and a burnt child dreads the fire may occur in authentic English, but this exercise requires the exact target proverb.
rules.zh: once bit, twice shy、once burned, twice shy 和 a burnt child dreads the fire 等相關形式可以出現在真實英語中，但本練習必須使用指定諺語。

rules.titleZh: 注意使用時的敏感程度
rules.en: The saying suits ordinary disappointments, mistakes and risks. In response to severe trauma, abuse or serious loss, it may sound dismissive or unsympathetic.
rules.zh: 這句諺語適合一般失望、錯誤和風險；回應嚴重創傷、虐待或重大損失時，可能令人覺得輕視對方或缺乏同理心。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using once bitten, twice shy. Type the whole sentence; the first word of the model answer is provided.
instructions.zh: 使用 once bitten, twice shy 改寫句子或完成回應。請輸入完整句子；每題已提供參考答案的第一個字。

questions.prompt: The bakery delivered my birthday cake a day late last year. I now check the delivery date carefully before ordering from it.
questions.promptZh: 那間餅店去年遲了一天才送到我的生日蛋糕。我現在向它訂購前，會仔細確認送貨日期。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: I now check the delivery date carefully before ordering from that bakery.
questions.answerZh: 吃過一次遲送的虧，我現在向那間餅店訂購前，會仔細確認送貨日期。

questions.prompt: An online seller sent Nina a damaged phone. She now reads every customer review before buying another phone online.
questions.promptZh: 一名網上賣家把損壞了的電話寄給 Nina。她現在網購另一部電話前，會閱讀每一則顧客評論。
questions.answer: Nina now reads every customer review before buying another phone online—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: Nina 吃過一次虧後，現在網購另一部電話前都會閱讀每則顧客評論。

questions.prompt: Omar’s previous group partner did none of the work. Omar is therefore careful about choosing the same partner again.
questions.promptZh: Omar 上次的小組伙伴完全沒有工作。因此，Omar 對再次選擇同一名伙伴十分謹慎。
questions.answer: For Omar, it is a case of once bitten, twice shy: he is careful about choosing the same group partner again.
questions.answerZh: 對 Omar 而言，這正是一朝被蛇咬、十年怕草繩：他對再次選擇同一名小組伙伴十分謹慎。

questions.prompt: The family’s hotel room was dirty on their last holiday. They now check recent photographs before booking a room.
questions.promptZh: 這個家庭上次旅行時入住的酒店房間十分骯髒。他們現在訂房前會查看近期照片。
questions.answer: After the dirty hotel room on their last holiday, the family now checks recent photographs before booking—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 上次旅行時遇過骯髒的酒店房間後，這個家庭現在訂房前會查看近期照片，畢竟吃過一次虧，自然更加小心。

questions.prompt: I lent a friend money, but the friend never repaid me. I will not lend that person more money.
questions.promptZh: 我曾借錢給一名朋友，但對方一直沒有還錢。我不會再借錢給那個人。
questions.answer: “Once bitten, twice shy,” I said, refusing to lend that friend more money.
questions.answerZh: 我拒絕再借錢給那名朋友，並說：「一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。」

questions.prompt: Eva’s writing app once lost an important piece of work. She now saves an extra copy of every document.
questions.promptZh: Eva 的寫作應用程式曾遺失一份重要文件。她現在會為每份文件額外保存一個副本。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: Eva now saves an extra copy of every document.
questions.answerZh: 有了上次遺失文件的教訓，Eva 現在會為每份文件額外保存一個副本。

questions.prompt: Hana paid for ten lessons, but the tutor repeatedly cancelled them. She now books only one lesson at a time.
questions.promptZh: Hana 支付了十堂課的費用，但導師多次取消課堂。她現在每次只會預訂一堂課。
questions.answer: Since her tutor repeatedly cancelled the lessons she had paid for, Hana books only one lesson at a time—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 導師多次取消她已付費的課堂後，Hana 現在每次只預訂一堂課；吃過一次虧，她自然更加小心。

questions.prompt: Ben felt ill after eating at that restaurant. He is now unwilling to eat there again.
questions.promptZh: Ben 在那間餐廳吃東西後感到不適。他現在不願再次到那裏用膳。
questions.answer: It is a case of once bitten, twice shy for Ben: after feeling ill there, he is unwilling to eat at the restaurant again.
questions.answerZh: 對 Ben 而言，這正是一朝被蛇咬、十年怕草繩：在那裏吃東西後感到不適，他便不願再次到該餐廳用膳。

questions.prompt: The cheap paint we bought began to fall off the wall within a month. We will choose a better brand next time.
questions.promptZh: 我們購買的廉價油漆在一個月內便開始從牆上剝落。下次我們會選擇較好的品牌。
questions.answer: The paint peeled within a month, so we will choose a better brand next time—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 油漆在一個月內便剝落，所以我們下次會選擇較好的品牌；有了上次教訓，自然不敢再大意。

questions.prompt: Amir once bought a fake concert ticket. He now buys tickets only from official websites.
questions.promptZh: Amir 曾經買到一張假音樂會門票。他現在只會在官方網站購買門票。
questions.answer: As the saying goes, once bitten, twice shy: after buying a fake concert ticket, Amir now buys tickets only from official websites.
questions.answerZh: 正所謂一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩；Amir 買過假音樂會門票後，現在只會在官方網站購票。

questions.prompt: Priya once missed a flight because her bus arrived very late. She will leave home much earlier next time.
questions.promptZh: Priya 曾因巴士嚴重延誤而錯過航班。下次她會提早很多離開家中。
questions.answer: After missing a flight because her bus was late, Priya will leave home much earlier next time—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: Priya 曾因巴士延誤而錯過航班，所以下次會提早很多離開家中；吃過一次虧，自然會更加謹慎。

questions.prompt: Marcus’s previous manager changed his pay after he had accepted the job. Marcus may refuse another job unless the pay is confirmed in writing.
questions.promptZh: Marcus 的上一名經理在他接受工作後更改了薪金。除非薪金以書面確認，否則 Marcus 可能會拒絕另一份工作。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: Marcus may refuse another job unless the pay is confirmed in writing.
questions.answerZh: 有了上次薪金被更改的經歷，除非薪金以書面確認，否則 Marcus 可能會拒絕另一份工作。

questions.prompt: I had lost all my photographs when my only storage drive stopped working. By the following year, I was keeping two copies of every photograph.
questions.promptZh: 我唯一的儲存裝置失靈時，所有照片都遺失了。到了下一年，我已開始為每張照片保存兩個副本。
questions.answer: By the following year, it was a case of once bitten, twice shy: I was keeping two copies of every photograph.
questions.answerZh: 到了下一年，我已汲取教訓，為每張照片保存兩個副本。

questions.prompt: A: Why will you not pay for a full year at the new gym? B: The last gym closed only two months after I joined.
questions.promptZh: 甲：你為甚麼不願支付新健身中心一整年的費用？乙：我加入上一間健身中心後僅兩個月，它便倒閉了。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: I will not pay for a full year until I know that the new gym is reliable.
questions.answerZh: 吃過上一間健身中心倒閉的虧，在確認新健身中心可靠前，我不會支付一整年的費用。

questions.prompt: The Chens’ first house had several hidden water leaks. When they bought their second home, they paid someone to check it carefully.
questions.promptZh: Chan 一家購買的第一間房屋有多處隱藏漏水問題。他們購買第二間房屋時，付費請人仔細檢查。
questions.answer: When the Chens bought their second home, they paid someone to check it carefully—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: Chan 一家購買第二間房屋時，付費請人仔細檢查；有了第一間房屋漏水的教訓，他們自然不敢大意。

questions.prompt: A school bus company had repeatedly arrived late. Before signing another agreement, the school decided to check the company’s record carefully.
questions.promptZh: 一間校巴公司曾多次遲到。學校決定在簽署另一份協議前，仔細查核該公司的紀錄。
questions.answer: The school will check the bus company’s record carefully before signing another agreement—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 學校會在簽署另一份協議前仔細查核校巴公司的紀錄，畢竟曾經遇過多次遲到，自然更加謹慎。

questions.prompt: Asha once developed a rash after using an unfamiliar skin cream. She now tests a small amount before using any new cream.
questions.promptZh: Asha 曾在使用一種陌生的護膚霜後出現紅疹。她現在使用任何新護膚霜前，都會先試用少量。
questions.answer: Because an unfamiliar skin cream once caused a rash, Asha now tests a small amount first—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 因為陌生的護膚霜曾令 Asha 出現紅疹，她現在會先試用少量；有了上次教訓，今次自然更加小心。

questions.prompt: The manager introduced the previous service too quickly, and many customers complained. This time, she will test the service first.
questions.promptZh: 經理上次太快推出新服務，結果很多顧客投訴。今次她會先測試服務。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: the manager will test the service before offering it to every customer.
questions.answerZh: 上次因太快推出服務而收到投訴後，經理今次會先測試服務，再向所有顧客提供。

questions.prompt: Jay shared his password with a teammate, who then changed his account settings. Jay no longer shares his password with anyone.
questions.promptZh: Jay 把密碼告訴一名隊友，而對方其後更改了他的帳戶設定。Jay 現在不再與任何人分享密碼。
questions.answer: After a teammate changed his account settings, Jay stopped sharing his password—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 隊友更改他的帳戶設定後，Jay 便不再分享密碼；吃過一次虧，自然不敢再次冒險。

questions.prompt: The club’s outdoor event was cancelled because it had no plan for rain. The club now always prepares an indoor plan.
questions.promptZh: 學會的戶外活動因沒有雨天安排而被取消。學會現在每次都會準備室內後備方案。
questions.answer: The club now always prepares an indoor plan for its outdoor events—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 學會上次因下雨而取消活動後，現在每次舉辦戶外活動都會準備室內後備方案。

questions.prompt: A: Why are you asking the builder for a written price? B: The last builder charged me much more than we had agreed.
questions.promptZh: 甲：你為甚麼要求建築工人提供書面報價？乙：上一名建築工人收取的費用比我們原先同意的高很多。
questions.answer: “Once bitten, twice shy,” I explained. “The last builder charged me much more than we had agreed.”
questions.answerZh: 我解釋道：「一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。上一名建築工人收取的費用比我們原先同意的高很多。」

questions.prompt: A: Are you going to use that travel website again? B: No. Last time, I arrived at the hotel and discovered that it had no record of my booking.
questions.promptZh: 甲：你會再次使用那個旅遊網站嗎？乙：不會。上次我到達酒店後，才發現酒店沒有我的預訂紀錄。
questions.answer: No, I will not use that travel website again—once bitten, twice shy. Last time, the hotel had no record of my booking.
questions.answerZh: 不會，我不會再次使用那個旅遊網站——一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩。上次酒店根本沒有我的預訂紀錄。

questions.prompt: A friend shared Suki’s private secret with other people. Suki is now careful about trusting people too quickly.
questions.promptZh: 一名朋友把 Suki 的私人秘密告訴其他人。Suki 現在不會太快信任別人。
questions.answer: After a friend shared her private secret, Suki became careful about trusting people too quickly—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 一名朋友把她的私人秘密告訴別人後，Suki 不再太快信任別人；吃過一次虧，她自然更加謹慎。

questions.prompt: Raj once paid an unknown seller in full, but the product never arrived. He now refuses to pay another unknown seller before receiving the item.
questions.promptZh: Raj 曾向一名陌生賣家支付全數款項，但貨品一直沒有送到。他現在拒絕在收到貨品前向另一名陌生賣家支付全數款項。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: Raj will not pay another unknown seller in full before receiving the item.
questions.answerZh: Raj 曾付款後收不到貨品，所以現在不會在收貨前向另一名陌生賣家支付全數款項。

questions.prompt: A restaurant owner added a new dish to the menu without testing it, and much of the food was wasted. She now prepares only a small amount of each new dish first.
questions.promptZh: 一名餐廳東主未經測試便把一道新菜式加入餐單，結果浪費了大量食物。她現在會先試做少量新菜式。
questions.answer: The restaurant owner now tests a small amount of each new dish before adding it to the menu—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 餐廳東主曾因未經測試便推出新菜式而浪費食物，所以現在會先試做少量；有了上次教訓，自然更小心。

questions.prompt: A student accidentally deleted the class’s only project file last year. The teacher now keeps two copies of every class file.
questions.promptZh: 一名學生去年意外刪除了全班唯一的項目檔案。老師現在會為每個班級檔案保存兩個副本。
questions.answer: Because a student deleted the class’s only project file last year, the teacher now keeps two copies—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 學生去年刪除了全班唯一的項目檔案，所以老師現在會保存兩個副本；吃過一次虧，自然不敢大意。

questions.prompt: Clara collected a parcel from a shop but later discovered that one item was missing. She now checks every parcel before leaving the shop.
questions.promptZh: Clara 從店舖領取包裹後，才發現其中一件貨品不見了。她現在離開店舖前都會檢查每個包裹。
questions.answer: The missing item made Clara check every parcel before leaving the shop—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 貨品曾經遺漏，令 Clara 現在離開店舖前都會檢查每個包裹；有了上次教訓，自然更加仔細。

questions.prompt: Joel thought a free trial would be easy to cancel, but the company charged him for three months. He now reads all the cancellation rules first.
questions.promptZh: Joel 以為免費試用可以輕易取消，但公司收取了他三個月的費用。他現在會先閱讀所有取消條款。
questions.answer: Once bitten, twice shy: after being charged for three months, Joel now reads the cancellation rules before starting a free trial.
questions.answerZh: Joel 曾在免費試用後被收取三個月費用，所以現在開始任何免費試用前都會閱讀取消條款。

questions.prompt: The group held last year’s picnic in an uncovered area, and everyone became too hot. This year, they have booked a covered area.
questions.promptZh: 小組去年在沒有遮蓋的地方舉行野餐，所有人都熱得受不了。今年他們預訂了有遮蓋的地方。
questions.answer: After last year’s picnic left everyone too hot, the group booked a covered area this year—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 去年野餐時所有人都熱得受不了，所以小組今年預訂了有遮蓋的地方；有了上次教訓，今次自然準備得更周全。

questions.prompt: Mei accepted too many volunteer duties and became exhausted before she could finish them. She now accepts only one volunteer duty at a time.
questions.promptZh: Mei 接受了太多義務工作，在完成所有工作前便已筋疲力盡。她現在每次只會接受一項義務工作。
questions.answer: For Mei, it was a case of once bitten, twice shy: after becoming exhausted, she began accepting only one volunteer duty at a time.
questions.answerZh: 對 Mei 而言，這正是吃過一次虧便加倍小心：筋疲力盡後，她開始每次只接受一項義務工作。

questions.prompt: Although Chloe’s new landlord seems friendly, she asks for every agreement in writing because her previous landlord unfairly kept part of her deposit.
questions.promptZh: 雖然 Chloe 的新業主看來十分友善，但她要求所有協議以書面確認，因為上一名業主曾不公平地扣起她部分按金。
questions.answer: Although Chloe’s new landlord seems friendly, she asks for every agreement in writing after unfairly losing part of her previous deposit—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 雖然 Chloe 的新業主看來十分友善，但她曾被上一名業主不公平地扣起部分按金，所以現在要求所有協議以書面確認。

questions.prompt: Aaron’s last online course was poorly taught. Before paying for another course, he now watches a sample lesson.
questions.promptZh: Aaron 上一個網上課程的教學質素很差。他現在支付另一個課程的費用前，會先觀看示範課堂。
questions.answer: Because his last online course was poorly taught, Aaron watches a sample lesson before paying for another one—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: Aaron 上一個網上課程的教學質素很差，所以現在付款報讀另一個課程前會先觀看示範課堂；吃過一次虧，自然更加謹慎。

questions.prompt: I know that airlines usually handle luggage properly. However, after an airline lost one of my bags, I began putting my contact details both inside and outside every bag.
questions.promptZh: 我知道航空公司通常會妥善處理行李。不過，一間航空公司遺失我的其中一件行李後，我開始在每個行李袋的內外都放上聯絡資料。
questions.answer: I know that airlines usually handle luggage properly, but after losing one bag, I now put my contact details both inside and outside every bag—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 我知道航空公司通常會妥善處理行李，但遺失過一件行李後，我現在會在每個行李袋的內外都放上聯絡資料。

questions.prompt: The team’s last order arrived several weeks late. If it uses the same seller again, it will place only a small first order.
questions.promptZh: 團隊上一次的訂單遲了數星期才送到。如果再次使用同一名賣家，團隊只會先下小額訂單。
questions.answer: If the team uses the same seller again, it will place only a small first order—once bitten, twice shy after the last late delivery.
questions.answerZh: 如果團隊再次使用同一名賣家，只會先下小額訂單；上次曾遇到嚴重延誤，今次自然更加謹慎。

questions.prompt: Nora has not stopped accepting invitations. However, after attending an event that was very different from its description, she now asks who will be there.
questions.promptZh: Nora 並沒有停止接受邀請。不過，她曾參加一個與宣傳描述完全不同的活動，所以現在會先詢問有哪些人出席。
questions.answer: Nora still accepts invitations, but she now asks who will be there after attending a badly described event—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: Nora 仍會接受邀請，但曾參加一個與宣傳描述完全不同的活動後，現在會先詢問有哪些人出席。

questions.prompt: A company’s previous project with another firm was never completed. The company may work with the firm again, but only through a short trial agreement.
questions.promptZh: 一間公司的上一個合作項目一直沒有完成。公司可能會再次與該機構合作，但只會先簽訂短期試行協議。
questions.answer: The company may work with the firm again, but only through a short trial agreement—once bitten, twice shy after the unfinished project.

questions.prompt: An old app lost many of Luis’s photographs. Even though a new app has good reviews, he wants to wait for more updates before using it.

questions.answer: Even though the new app has good reviews, Luis is waiting for more updates after an older app lost his photographs—once bitten, twice shy.

questions.answer: The family has not stopped eating out, but it now checks recent restaurant reviews after a bad holiday meal—once bitten, twice shy.

questions.answer: The school knows that one poor coach does not make every coach unreliable, but it now interviews each one carefully—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 學校知道不能因一名差劣教練便認為所有教練都不可靠，但有了上次教訓，現在會仔細面試每一名教練。

questions.prompt: Grace gave money to an organisation that falsely claimed to be a charity. She now checks every organisation carefully before donating.
questions.promptZh: Grace 曾捐款給一個假稱是慈善機構的組織。她現在捐款前會仔細查核每個組織。
questions.answer: After giving money to a false charity, Grace now checks every organisation carefully before donating—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: Grace 曾捐款給假慈善機構，所以現在捐款前會仔細查核每個組織；吃過一次虧，自然會加倍小心。

questions.answer: When the new seller asked for full payment before delivery, the shop owner offered only a small deposit—once bitten, twice shy after another seller had disappeared with her money.

questions.answer: The residents will not support another town plan without clear dates after the previous one was quietly abandoned—once bitten, twice shy.

questions.promptZh: 一名場地東主曾收取樂隊的款項後取消預訂。樂隊經理現在只會在取得書面協議後預訂場地，而且只會支付小額訂金。

questions.answer: Although the new flat looked fine, the couple tested every tap after experiencing serious water problems in their previous home—once bitten, twice shy.

questions.answerZh: 去年學校旅行的巴士沒有到達，所以老師今次核對了兩次預訂，並保存了司機的電話號碼。

questions.prompt: Rain completely ruined the club’s last outdoor fair. The club may organise another one, but only if it can reserve a covered area.
questions.promptZh: 大雨完全破壞了學會上一次的戶外市集。學會可能會再次舉辦，但前提是能夠預訂有遮蓋的地方。
questions.answer: The club may hold another outdoor fair, but only if it can reserve a covered area—once bitten, twice shy after rain ruined the last one.
questions.answerZh: 學會可能會再次舉辦戶外市集，但前提是能預訂有遮蓋的地方；上次活動被大雨破壞後，今次自然不敢大意。

questions.prompt: The company released its previous app update too quickly, and many customers complained. Even with a close deadline, the manager now refuses to release an update before testing it.
questions.promptZh: 公司上一次太快推出應用程式更新，結果很多顧客投訴。即使限期迫近，經理現在也拒絕在完成測試前推出更新。
questions.answer: Even with a close deadline, the manager refuses to release the update before testing it after the last rushed version caused many complaints—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 即使限期迫近，經理也拒絕在測試前推出更新；上一個匆忙推出的版本引起大量投訴，所以今次自然加倍謹慎。

questions.prompt: A: Would you invest in your friend’s new café? B: I might, but my previous investment was never repaid. I would need to see a clear business plan first.
questions.promptZh: 甲：你會投資朋友的新咖啡店嗎？乙：可能會，但我上一次投資的款項一直沒有歸還。我需要先看到一份清楚的營運計劃。
questions.answer: I might still invest in the café, but only after seeing a clear business plan because my previous investment was never repaid—once bitten, twice shy.
questions.answerZh: 我可能仍會投資咖啡店，但必須先看到清楚的營運計劃；我上一次投資的款項一直沒有歸還，所以今次不敢輕率決定。
